title: Manhunt on for gunmen in Zamboanga del Sur couple's slay

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A married couple was shot dead in a dark and secluded area in Pitogo town, Zamboanga del Sur, on Tuesday, prompting a joint manhunt by police and military forces. Col. Bonifacio Arañas Jr., provincial director of the Zamboanga del Sur Police Provincial Office (ZSPPO), strongly condemned the killings in Purok 7, Barangay Panubigan, calling it a “senseless act of violence.” “This senseless act of violence has no place in our communities, and those responsible must be held accountable before the law,” Arañas said in a statement on Wednesday.
